summary: Sheet #28 (B2B/Contractor & Pro Services) end-to-end verified. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass covering pro apply→pending→verify→ban lifecycle, 403 gate on pro-only endpoints, admin-only vetting endpoints, full job lifecycle (draft → proposal_sent → approved → in_progress → completed with jobs_completed increment), client permissions (unrelated user 403, pro cannot approve, cannot review before completed), messaging both roles, invoice create/send updating outstanding stats, payment guard returns 400 with 'payouts' message when pro has no Stripe Connect account, and Weather API returning current + advisories with the new WEATHER_API_KEY (Austin — Sunny 93.9°F w/ hot-weather advisory). react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings across app: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — cosmetic React Native Web deprecation warnings; not blocking, but worth cleaning up.
Expo doctor: expo@54.0.34 (expected ~54.0.35), expo-font@14.0.11 (expected ~14.0.12), expo-router@6.0.23 (expected ~6.0.24) — recommend `npx expo install --check` to align.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: run `npx expo install --check` to bump expo/expo-font/expo-router to expected patch versions.
Optional: replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` and image `style.resizeMode` with `props.resizeMode` to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~4960 lines). Sheet #28 block (~1678–2115) is well organized but the overall file should be split into modules per sheet — not new to this iteration.
Pro apply reuses `email` from the auth user (good); invoice/pay endpoint properly gates on `charges_enabled` before Stripe call — no PII leaks observed.
Passlib+bcrypt log warning ('module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') is benign but noisy in backend logs; safe to pin passlib>=1.7.5 or downgrade bcrypt<4.
